daily.today_energy: Your vibe is giving intentional rebirth energy. The cosmos is nudging you toward authenticity today—those things you've been sitting on? Time to let them breathe. Trust your gut more than your overthinking brain.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the real you lately, and honestly, that's the whole point. Whether you're single or coupled, today's about showing up as yourself without the filters. Vulnerability hits different when it's genuine.
daily.career: Your ideas are sharper than usual, and people are actually listening. This is the day to pitch that thing you've been workshopping in your head. Your unique perspective is literally what they need right now.
daily.health: Your energy feels best when you're moving in ways that feel good, not obligatory. Whether it's dancing, walking, or stretching—find the movement that makes you feel alive. Your body's asking for joy, not punishment.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your communication game this week. You're basically radiating that 'I know something you don't' energy, and honestly? People are picking up on it. Trust the weird intuitive hits—they're steering you right.
weekly.love: Your person (or potential person) is noticing the mysterious new aura you're giving. Don't overthink it—lean into the authenticity. Single? This week's about knowing your worth, not settling for surface-level connections.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Whether it's speaking up in meetings or pivoting your approach, this is your moment to show what you're capable of. The energy supports bold moves and creative solutions.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more intentional rest, not just scrolling in bed. Movement that feels good—whether that's dancing, walking, or stretching—will shift your whole mood. Listen to what you actually need.
